name: com.boatopoly/boatopoly
title: Boatopoly
description: Sell and find boats on Boatopoly, the boat marketplace, right from your AI chat.

tools.name: get_import_guide
tools.description: Returns how to describe boats for Boatopoly: the fields of one boat with their units, the boat types with their current categories, the allowed values and an example. Call it once before handing boats over.

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl) or Latvian (lv) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.

tools.name: submit_boats
tools.description: Hands up to 100 boats over to Boatopoly, each an object in the format of get_import_guide. Returns a link for the seller: signed in to Boatopoly, the seller checks every boat in a preview and creates drafts from them. Nothing is published and no account is touched by this call. The link is valid for 3 days.

boats.description: The boats, one object each, with the fields of get_import_guide (boat_type, category, title, manufacturer, model, price, …).

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl) or Latvian (lv) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.

tools.name: search_boats
tools.description: Searches the boats for sale on Boatopoly (active adverts) with the filters of the website's search: words (manufacturer, model, words of the title or description, or an advert number), the boat type, the manufacturer, the model, new or used, the country, the price in euros, the length in metres and the year built. Returns the matching boats (price, length, year, place, the link to each advert) and the number of matches, at most 20 per call; get_boat gives the details of one.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "Bavaria Cruiser 34" or "catamaran"; or an advert number.

boat_type.description: The boat type: power = Motor boat, sail = Sailboat, small = Small boat, vessel = Vessel, other-boats = Other boats, trailer = Trailer, motor = Motor, equipment = Equipment, moorings = Moorings, other-equipment = Other equipment.

model.description: The model, or a part of it, e.g. "Cruiser 34".

country.description: The country of the boat as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, several separated by commas, e.g. "DE" or "HR,IT,GR".

year_min.description: Built in this year or later.

year_max.description: Built in this year or earlier.

sort.description: The order: relevance (with words, the default then), newest (otherwise the default), price, length or year.

offset.description: Skip this many matches: the next page of the same search.

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl) or Latvian (lv) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.

tools.name: get_boat
tools.description: Returns the details of one boat for sale on Boatopoly: price, dimensions, year, engines, equipment notes, the description (in the language of the conversation when the seller has one), photos and the link to the advert. Give the advert number (e.g. 30012) or the link that search_boats returned. The buyer contacts the seller on the advert page; this tool sends no message.

boat.description: The advert number (e.g. "30012") or the link of the advert.

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl) or Latvian (lv) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.
